caption: The drawing depicts a tall, freestanding grandfather clock set against a plain, light beige background. The clock case is predominantly a reddish-brown wood color, accented with gold detailing along the edges and panels. The base of the clock features a large oval outlined in gold, while the midsection has a taller, vertically oriented oval and further gold-lined edges. The clock face is rectangular with a white background, black Roman numerals, and black hands, enclosed in a section with ornate gold and blue designs, and topped by a semicircular arch with additional decorative detailing. The upper part of the clock case is adorned with three gold finials and a curved, ornate crestwork. The clock stands on four short, curved legs, and the overall design is detailed and symmetrical, with emphasis on wood grain and ornate, classical decoration.
title: Clock, Tall
